description: The Alberta Education package reports capacity and utilisation rates for K–12 public school facilities. Public school jurisdictions submit enrolment each year, and the department adjusts enrolment and utilisation for additional space needs of some students. The XLSX distribution label identifies school year 2023–2024. Package time-span fields are empty. This measures education-facility service capacity and use. The metadata does not establish room-level geometry, exact capacity units, all calculation rules or coverage outside the labelled school year. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source identifiers and descriptive metadata. The native licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual payload access and costs remain unverified. No linked dataset, workbook, document, legal text, model or code body was retrieved.
